shortDescription: The West African market was quiet on Monday, while crude differentials had started firming due to shipping rates going down.

children: The West African market was quiet on Monday, while crude differentials had started firming due to shipping rates going down.

Shipping analysis firm Kpler said in a note last week that differentials on some West African grades had picked up due to a drop in shipping rates, which could also be linked to greater buying interest from Asia
